result.title: VG3R: Video Generation Model for Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction
result.summary: Video generation models are widely used as 3D priors for novel view synthesis and 3D scene generation. Fine-tuned for perception, generation models also excel at dense prediction such as depth estimation. However, methods that apply video generation models to 3D reconstruction either predict depth without cameras or generate geometry and estimate cameras through many iterative denoising steps, which makes them slower. In this paper, we present $\textbf{VG3R}$, which turns a pretrained video generation model into a feed-forward 3D reconstruction model. Our key observation is that such a model already captures the depth and camera motion of a video, but not in the form required for reconstruction. We introduce two components: $\textit{clip-level shift prediction}$, which corrects depth distortion caused by the unknown shift in decoded inverse depth, and a $\textit{multi-layer camera head}$, which predicts per-frame cameras parameters by combining features across transformer blocks. Using Wan2.1 as its video backbone, VG3R reconstructs a scene and estimate the camera of every frame without iterative denoising. It achieves the lowest ATE and reconstruction errors among methods built on video generation models, runs about 4 and 14 times faster than Aether and Geo4D. VG3R also demonstrates competitive depth estimation and 3D reconstruction performance compared with geometry foundation models. Project page: https://github.com/KTH-RPL/VG3R

AI.brief_summary: 将预训练视频生成模型（Wan2.1）改造为前馈 3D 重建模型：用片段级位移预测校正逆深度解码中的畸变，并用跨 transformer 层的相机头直接回归逐帧相机参数，从而免去迭代去噪。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「生成模型内部已含深度与相机运动、但形式不适配重建」的观察，以及跨层读出几何量的做法，可能类比 LVR 中内部状态是否保留几何证据、如何从 latent 中读取任务必要信息的问题，可供核查。
